summary.plain: DAMA/LIBRA was a 250 kg array of sodium iodide crystals in the Gran Sasso underground laboratory, successor to DAMA/NaI. From 2003 it recorded a yearly rise and fall in its signal that the team attributes to dark matter, and the data taking is reported to have ended in 2024. Other experiments have not confirmed the signal.
summary.technical: 25 NaI(Tl) crystals of 9.70 kg (about 250 kg) read by two photomultipliers each, in a sealed copper box with Cu/Pb/Cd/polyethylene shielding and concrete at LNGS. Phase1 (2003-2010, 2 keV software threshold, 1.04 ton yr, 7 annual cycles), phase2 (new Hamamatsu R6233MOD PMTs, 1 keV threshold; 2011 onwards). The collaboration reports a model-independent annual modulation of the single-hit rate in 2-6 keV at 13.7 sigma C.L. for the full 2.86 ton yr exposure including DAMA/NaI.
